title: James H. Lane Ranch, Barn, One Mile South of Richfield on Highway 26, Richfield, Lincoln County, ID
notes: Significance: The Riverwood Ranch's barn is significant under Criterion A, because of its associations with broad patterns of south-central Idaho agricultural history and settlement.  It is also significant under Criterion C.  The barn represents the use of basalt as a building material in south-central Idaho during the early twentieth century.
